notes.title: v1.1.0 Patch Notes
notes.content:
[h1] PC 1.1.0 Patch Notes (The Cosmic Wheel Sisterhood) [/h1]

·Fixed a bug in which several readings could appear twice.
·Fixed a bug in which the [spoiler] Gaethëryan [/spoiler] achievement wouldn’t unlock.
·Fixed a bug in which Jasmine [spoiler] would offer you herbs to help Grethe even if her ritual was already completed. [/spoiler]
·Fixed a soft lock after [spoiler] Dahlia’s visit to talk about about the dagger for Grethe, asking you to make a card but not having enough resources. [/spoiler]
·Fixed a soft lock in Chapter 5 when taking a break during [spoiler]Patrice’s political analysis. [/spoiler]
·Fixed a bug in which Junreisha’s [spoiler] destroyed cards wouldn’t return the resources of the destroyed cards. [/spoiler]
·Fixed crash in Chapter 6 when trying to [spoiler] “Cuddle with Grethe” while having Jasmine and Patrice talking about the upcoming election in the upper part of Fortuna’s Home. [/spoiler]
·Fixed crash in Chapter 7 [spoiler] right at the end of the scene on your trip with Ábramar. [/spoiler]
·Fixed crash in Chapter 7 [spoiler] when reading “Ábramar is using me to take revenge on the coven. [/spoiler]
·Fixed a crash in Chapter 7 [spoiler] debate scene [/spoiler] that would lead to a corrupted save file.
·Fixed [spoiler] Epilogue’s “Gossip” repeating itself. [/spoiler]

[url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1340480/eventcomments/3812913197997433034?snr=2_9_100003_]If you're having issues with the Win32 function 0x887a0005 bug, please click here![/url]

[b] Thank you so much everyone for playing our game, for your support and your patience! <3 [/b]

notes.title: Steam Hotfix (Second Playthrough Bug)
notes.content:
Hey everyone! We just updated the game with a hotfix for those having trouble with a second, consecutive playthrough. 

If you start a NG+ playthrough and find any issues after updating the game, [u][url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1340480/discussions/0/3812913197988970375/]we would appreciate it a lot if you reported them to us![/url][/u]

If you were already on a second playthrough and were having issues, sadly the only thing we can suggest is starting a new game altogether. We are deeply sorry for the progress lost in the way.

Otherwise, [b]we are working hard at fixing all other [u][url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1340480/discussions/1/3812913565881018505/]⁠Known Issues[/url][/u] and will have a new patch as soon as possible![/b]

[h3][b]Thank you so much for playing our game and for your support![/b][/h3]
